author: Inside Edition
description: Closing arguments began Monday in Kouri Richins' murder trial that has been gripping the nation. Richins' husband, Eric, was found dead at the family home. A year later, Richins promoted her children's book about grief on a local tv station before getting arrested in connection with her husband's death. During the trial, bodycam video was shown, Richins' former boyfriend testified, the defense wrapped up without calling a witness. After the closing arguments, Richins' fate will be in the hands of the jury.
title: Closing Arguments Begin In Kouri Richins' Murder Trial

description: Police in Hollywood, Florida, had a good laugh recently after a pig got loose and ran away from a nearby farm. Bodycam footage released by the Hollywood Police Department showed officers chasing the ham on a busy street before catching it and bringing it back to its owners.
title: Florida Police Chase a Runway Piggy and Bring It All the Way Home

author: Inside Edition
description: Signs of life in Death Valley? One of the dryest, hottest places on earth is experiencing a phenomenon known as a Superbloom. Officials with the National Park Service say wild seeds scattered throughout the area received enough rain water for them to grow roots. Wildflowers are creating the focal point or the perfect backdrop for rare photos since this happens roughly once a decade. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Flowers Spring Up Across Death Valley In Rare Superbloom Event
